legacy_refs.title: Spine-authoring bootstrap: gate-row storage + spec-body sync
legacy_refs.description: Build the deterministic-gate storage + the spec-body criteria/gate authoring system that I13's in-band TUI waves require to close. Backend/advisory waves; authored via the current CLI.

legacy_refs.title: TUI surfaces + folded scope (authored via spec-body)
legacy_refs.description: The in-band TUI build-out + folded B069/B011/B018, authored through the I12 spec-body machinery so every wave closes on a deterministic gate.

legacy_refs.title: P30 I01 cadence and binding floor (BIND-*)
legacy_refs.description: Bootstraps the meta-gate and shift-left prevention every later P30 iter runs under, mechanizing the one rule: never ship an idle contract again. A wave is done only when its contract is BOUND to a real call path with a binding-proof test that asserts it fires and a negative-path test that asserts it blocks when violated. This is a binding iter, not a build iter: it wires already-built contracts onto the paths they were specified for and proves they fire. Ten waves, 13.5 EU.

legacy_refs.title: TUI reskin into the Eae cosmic-terminal render language
legacy_refs.description: Render + theme only reskin of the live Textual TUI into the Eae cosmic-terminal language: rotate the accent to green, add a lifecycle sigil layer, unify the bar renderer and retire the dead Braille path, two-tone the Eae wordmark, and frame honest-empty panes as calm next-actions. Spawn-free; mutates no state/daemon/gate logic. Lands before the P30 data iters. Every wave binds a contract to a real render path proven by a snapshot golden plus, where a key is touched, affordance_parity.

legacy_refs.title: Skill-output structure — validate typed bodies at emit + reconcile prose
legacy_refs.description: Close P30 observation 1: skill output drifts because the per-skill typed body model is never validated at emit and the descriptive prose has drifted from shipped P29 symbols. Bind body-validation-at-emit in run_skill (SKILL-1..3,6), validate_prose over envelope bodies (SKILL-5), lean/explain presets (SKILL-4), reconcile registry.py prose (SKILL-7), and a prose-vs-symbol drift oracle (SKILL-8). Each binding gets a fires-on-happy-path proof and a blocks-on-violation negative test.

legacy_refs.title: Authoring richness — bind intent + invariant + mockup-golden contracts
legacy_refs.description: Make wave plans dense by binding three authoring-time contracts P29 shipped idle or optional: require a populated IntentBrief on every authored wave, require the non-circular affordance_parity/transition_coverage invariant gates on UI-scope waves, and capture the operator-picked mockup as an independent ASCII golden diffed at close. Cures OBSERVATION 2a, decision #8 (independence/circularity break), and the discarded-mockup gap. Presence and measurability only; faithfulness is deferred.

legacy_refs.title: Harness EU instrumentation (EUCAP — capture, attribute, enforce runtime)
legacy_refs.description: Close OBSERVATION 3 of the P30 design (elapsed_eu reads 0.00 everywhere): the operator-driven Claude Code session that runs every wave is used by eawf but never instruments it. Wire a SESSION_END hook + statusline sidecar to capture the CC cost block, bracket each wave by a claim-time RuntimeBaseline and a close-time delta, persist the delta into ActualSummary, and add a gate that WARNS then REFUSES a silent 0-EU close unless --no-runtime is passed. Ships the CC adapter only.

legacy_refs.title: Fleet substrate — bind the eawf-spawned dispatch fleet + prove it fires
legacy_refs.description: Close the gap between what P29 lit on the spawn floor and what is still idle: bind the spawned executor's real self-report (not a daemon stub), add a headless spawn caller, inject Zone-3 role rules at dispatch, add a grounded repair re-dispatch, and pin binding-proof + negative-path tests so each substrate change provably fires on a real call path and blocks on the negative path.

legacy_refs.title: TUI surface data-fill plus new U-surfaces (cost, jury, control plane)
legacy_refs.description: Bind the typed state that already exists onto the live TUI: full CriterionSpec rows, gates, agent-report evidence, provenance, and budget-vs-consumed runtime in wave-detail, plus the fleet claim/dispatch/watch/verdict chain and campaign-create CRUD. Then add five mock-delivered U-surfaces: per-session cost (U1), jury-ballot drill (U2), research control plane (U3), incident timeline (U4), and fleet parity lens (U5). Every wave binds to a real call path with a binding-proof and a negative test.

legacy_refs.title: Multi-scope dashboards — workspace + user scope reskin
legacy_refs.description: Reskin the two non-repo scopes into the cosmic-terminal language the mocks fix as the brief: WorkspaceScreen (press w, the multi-repo grid + registry pane) and UserScreen/PortfolioTable (press u, the cross-repo portfolio). Each repo row leads with a lifecycle sigil, carries a green status-tinted bar, and the grid, portfolio, and _zoom quadrant share one focus tint. Deps the I02 reskin for sigils.py and the bar renderer; this iter consumes those symbols and adds no new render primitive.

legacy_refs.title: Trust validation — validate, calibrate, and stage the cross-vendor jury
legacy_refs.description: Grow teeth on the trust pillar: build the silver/gold validation cohort, compute jury calibration (Fleiss-kappa, Brier/ECE, Wilson lower-bound, per-juror ballot persistence), un-idle the per-item spec jury and reliability-weighted aggregation, and stage the jury from advisory to blocking only after it earns authority on eawf's own labeled distribution. This iter OWNS the calibration build; the I10 quality iter only consumes its metrics. The honest-negative surface ships even data-starved.

legacy_refs.title: Quality enforcement — make every gate fire
legacy_refs.description: The cross-cutting QA iter. Converts the 1392 legacy no-op criteria to real falsifying gates, un-idles the registered audit-DSL kinds, adds the jury-calibration precondition kind (build lives in I08), wires the two inert spawn-safety guarantees, raises coverage, and cleans the backlog.

legacy_refs.title: Track substrate — dormant entity rename + kind-parametrized seam

Three independent tracks; ~7-8 EU. Track 1 is highest impact, Track 3 lowest urgency.
